mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts above 850 thousand units and retail sales above 420,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 420000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 900 thousand units, it signals robust construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls above 136,000 and unemployment below 7.5% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 136000 and UNRATE < 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over the prior 3 months signals inflationary pressures that raise discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0, it signals a manufacturing contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.
